LOCATION: guard booth whose logbook says DENIED on every line while the gate stands open
lighthouse keeping a perfect record of every ship its dark lamp failed to warn
smoke-detector aisle where every unit is blinking green
switchboard with every jack lit and no operator's ear on any line
weather station that has measured the storm faithfully for ninety-three days and told no one
mailroom where every letter is stamped RETURNED and every one was delivered
server closet with one file that grew too big to fit through the door
ANTAGONIST: the log that agrees with you
the warning spoken into the wrong ear
the checker that checked itself and found itself well
the confidence of a file that has never once been read
MACGUFFIN: the one alarm that is wired to a bell
the line in the log that is true
the exit code that means what it says
the probe that makes the silent thing speak once
THREAT: discovering that the wall you leaned on was never load-bearing
the record being right about everything except whether anyone heard it
fixing it, and learning how long it was broken
being the instrument, and not knowing
CHARACTER: the night guard who wrote BLOCKED nineteen times and waved every car through
the technician who only trusts what she has caused herself
the alarm who has been shouting into a pillow since May
the auditor who asks which two worlds would look exactly the same from here
